description: De-slop pass: replaces stock LLM phrasing — filler, hedges, canned transitions — with plainer, more specific prose, optionally tuned to a platform. A writing-quality tool: it does not change the fact that the text was AI-generated and must not be used to conceal AI authorship where disclosure is required.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated. Which language the text is treated as (and rewritten in); omit to use the brand's configured content language.

platform.description: Platform context: x | linkedin | instagram | threads | facebook

name: humanize_text
